title: AccessMembershipRemovedPayload
description: Payload of `access.membership.removed` version 1: a membership was removed. The person's identity and their other memberships remain. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner, or `null` for a platform membership. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

user_id.description: The person who was the member.
